items.translation: 大多数开发者将希望定义自己的 `main` 方法，并调用 run` 方法。

items.source: Static helper that can be used to exit a SpringApplication and obtain a code indicating success (0) or otherwise. Does not throw exceptions but should print stack traces of any encountered. Applies the specified ExitCodeGenerators in addition to any Spring beans that implement ExitCodeGenerator. When multiple generators are available, the first non-zero exit code is used. Generators are ordered based on their Ordered implementation and @Order annotation.
items.translation: 这是一个可用于退出 SpringApplication 并获取表示成功（0）或其他结果的代码的静态辅助方法。该方法不会抛出异常，但应打印任何遇到的堆栈跟踪。除了应用指定的 ExitCodeGenerators 外，还会应用所有实现 ExitCodeGenerator 的 Spring Bean。当有多个生成器可用时，使用第一个非零退出代码。生成器的顺序基于其 Ordered 实现和 @Order 注解。

items.source: Template method delegating to configurePropertySources(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[]) and configureProfiles(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[]) in that order.
items.translation: 委托给以下方法的模板方法：首先调用 configurePropertySources(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[])，然后调用 configureProfiles(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[])。

items.source: Template method delegating to configurePropertySources(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[]) and configureProfiles(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[]) in that order. Override this method for complete control over Environment customization, or one of the above for fine-grained control over property sources or profiles, respectively.
items.translation: 委托给 configurePropertySources(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[])` 和 configureProfiles(ConfigurableEnvironment, String[])` 的模板方法，顺序如上。若要完全控制 Environment 定制，请重写此方法；若要对属性源或配置文件进行细粒度控制，则分别重写上述方法之一。

items.source: Create an application from an existing main method that can run with additional @Configuration or bean classes. This method can be helpful when writing a test harness that needs to start an application with additional configuration.
items.translation: 从现有的 `main` 方法创建一个可以配合额外的 `@Configuration` 或 Bean 类运行的应用程序。当编写需要启动带有额外配置的应用程序的测试框架时，此方法非常有用。

items.source: Configure which profiles are active (or active by default) for this application environment. Additional profiles may be activated during configuration file processing through the spring.profiles.active property.

items.translation: 可抛出以静默退出正在运行的SpringApplication而无需处理运行失败的异常。

items.source: Used to configure and run an augmented SpringApplication where additional configuration should be applied.
items.translation: 用于配置和运行增强的SpringApplication，以便应用额外的配置。

items.source: Strategy method used to create the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于创建ApplicationContext的策略方法。

items.source: Create an application from an existing main method that can run with additional @Configuration or bean classes.
items.translation: 从现有的 `main` 方法创建一个应用程序，使其能够使用额外的 `@Configuration` 或 bean 类运行。

items.source: Apply any relevant post-processing to the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 对 ApplicationContext` 应用任何相关的后处理。

items.source: Sets if a CommandLinePropertySource should be added to the application context in order to expose arguments.
items.translation: 设置是否将 CommandLinePropertySource 添加到应用程序上下文中，以暴露参数。

items.source: Sets if the created ApplicationContext should have a shutdown hook registered.
items.translation: 设置是否应为创建的ApplicationContext注册关闭钩子。

items.source: Returns the Log for the application.
items.translation: 返回应用程序的Log。

items.source:
Configure which profiles are active (or active by default) for this application
environment.
items.translation: 配置此应用程序环境中哪些配置文件处于活动状态（或默认处于活动状态）。

items.source: A basic main that can be used to launch an application.
items.translation: 一个可用于启动应用程序的基本主程序。

items.source: Register that the given exception has been logged.
items.translation: 注册给定的异常已被记录。

items.source:
Sets if bean definition overriding, by registering a definition with the same name
as an existing definition, should be allowed.
items.translation: 设置是否允许通过注册与现有定义具有相同名称的定义来覆盖 Bean 定义。

items.source:
Sets whether to allow circular references between beans and automatically try to
resolve them.
items.translation: 设置是否允许 Bean 之间的循环引用并自动尝试解析它们。

items.source: Sets the factory that will be called to create the application context.
items.translation: 设置将用于创建应用程序上下文的工厂。

items.source: Sets the mode used to display the banner when the application runs.
items.translation: 设置应用程序运行时显示横幅的模式。

items.source: Sets if the application is headless and should not instantiate AWT.
items.translation: 设置应用程序是否为无头模式且不应实例化 AWT。

items.source: Sets if beans should be initialized lazily.
items.translation: 设置是否应该懒式初始化 Bean。

items.source: Sets if the application information should be logged when the application starts.
items.translation: 设置是否在应用程序启动时记录应用程序信息。

items.source:
Set a specific main application class that will be used as a log source and to
obtain version information.
items.translation: 设置一个特定的主应用程序类，将其用作日志源并获取版本信息。

items.source: Set additional sources that will be used to create an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 设置将用于创建 ApplicationContext 的附加资源。

items.source: Sets the type of web application to be run.
items.translation: 设置要运行的 Web 应用程序的类型。

items.source: webApplicationType - the web application type
items.translation: webApplicationType - Web 应用程序类型

items.source: environment - the environment
items.translation: environment - 环境

items.source: resourceLoader - the resource loader
items.translation: resourceLoader - 资源加载器
